raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Some raw_customers rows (60 of 200) carry numeric region codes ('01'-'04') instead of region names. The pipeline passes these codes straight through, so silver_customers and gold_region_daily split regions across codes and names. raw_region_map gives a one-to-one mapping (01=WEST, 02=EAST, 03=NORTH, 04=SOUTH) that can translate the codes.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.85, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_customers": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_customers AS SELECT c.customer_id, upper(coalesce(m.region_name, c.region)) AS region FROM raw_customers c LEFT JOIN raw_region_map m ON trim(c.region) = trim(m.region_code)"}}
